title: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup (Phở Gà) - Vicky Pham
ldKeywords: pho, chicken pho, chicken phở, pho recipe, chicken pho recipe, pho ga, pho ga recipe, quick pho ga recipe, easy pho ga recipe, pho ga, how to make chicken pho, pho ga ingredients, pho garnishes, chicken phở, what is pho ga made of, pho ga ingredients, best chicken pho, best chicken pho recipe, authentic pho ga recipe, pho ga spices, vietnamese chicken noodle soup, vietnamese chicken pho, vietnamese chicken noodle soup recipe, authentic vietnamese chicken noodle soup, authentic vietnamese pho ga, authentic vietnamese chicken noodle soup recipe, authentic vietnamese pho ga recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: ¼ cup thinly sliced yellow onion
¼ cup thinly sliced green onions
Red chili peppers or jalapenos (thinly sliced)
Shredded cabbage, Thai basil, bean sprouts (optional)
ldInstructionsRaw: Place the ginger and shallots on a baking tray and roast in a toaster oven or air fryer at 400°F for about 15 minutes, or until lightly charred and fragrant. In a small dry frying pan, toast the pho spices over medium heat for 30 seconds to 1 minute, just until they release their aroma without smoking. Set aside.

In a large stock pot, add the chicken, roasted ginger, roasted onion, green onion, cilantro, and water. Add the toasted spices as well, either loose or wrapped in a spice ball or cheesecloth. Bring everything to a boil, then reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Leave the pot uncovered and cook for about 1 hour.

Carefully remove the chicken and let it cool slightly before shredding the meat by hand or chopping it into smaller pieces. Set the chicken aside. Remove all solids from the stock then then season to taste with fish sauce, salt, or sugar.
Prepare the garnishes and any additional vegetables you want to use. Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Place rice noodles in each bowl and top with shredded chicken. Ladle in hot broth, then garnish with your choice of herbs, vegetables, lime wedges, and sauces. Serve immediately and enjoy!
